notes.title: Dark magic is live with 40% discount!
notes.content:

Dark magic brings all new adventures to the Castle explorer. Introducing new cards to challenge you, a new character to play and game mechanics, it’s time for your final showdown within the Castle.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1497350/Castle_Explorer__Dark_Magic/]Dark Magic Store URL[/url]

[list]
[*]6 new crypt cards
[*]5 new below cards
[*]4 new corpse cards
[*]4 new search/trap cards
[*]2 new door cards
[*]9 new room cards
[*]1 new hero
[*]Rewards from killing monsters.
[*]Monsters can spawn on tiles.
[*]Potions have been made stronger. New effects, cure negative buffs and no longer take a turn to drink.
[*]New exciting effects for the book of magic.

[*]Global effects for wizard rotate events.

notes.title: Join CastleExplorer beta test branch
notes.content:
Feel free to join as a beta tester. 
You will see new contents, features, and game mechanics before they become public.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27457628/842730d1f7d306f8c7458012a7ea24aa00b37b82.png[/img]

If you want to join as a beta tester, please follow this guide: 
1. Go into CastleExplorer steam game properties.
2. Click on Beta tab and opt in. 
There is no password.
Note, you can always undo this action and resume the stable CastleExplorer branch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27457628/23500060a4ab356bb9f17e20e09feba078aa078f.png[/img]

Disclaimer: The Beta branch is an unreleased version of the game that may contain bugs, crashes, etc. We do not advise you to play on it unless you are aware of this and it doesn't bother you.

notes.title: Heroes and rings is live with 40% discount!
notes.content:
[h1]Heroes and rings is live with 40% discount![/h1]
[h2][b]9 new Heroes ready to confronts the dark castle[/b][/h2]
[list]
    [*] Play as Urafeus a mystical wizard who uses magic spells to twist the maze and defeats his foes.
    [*] Play as Dwyght a sneaky thief who easily detect secrets in the castle.
    [*] Play as Dazzaxath a mighty Chaos warrior who uses dark power to survive.
    [*] Play as Romulus a fast scout who travel around with ease.
    [*] Play as Gretnas a strong gladiator with no fear from foes or traps.
    [*] Play as Maleriona a mystical dragon princess who uses her dragon to protect herself.
    [*] Play as Kobberknight a warrior with a magical spear and trustworthy cat pet.
    [*] Play as Gruddaes a dwarf with anger issues ready to smash everything.
    [*] Play as Stillstreak a Ninja with a dozen weapons to kill every living being.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27457628/d3e6369ce462de59b8aa8f2eb33183ece7d50d63.gif[/img]

[h2][b]4 new mystical rings[/b][/h2]
[list]
    [*] Ring of transformation with the power to change a room to your desire.
    [*] Ring of luck with the power to change an event to your favour.
    [*] Ring of teleport with the power to escape from dark below.
    [*] Ring of Vision with the power to easily find what you seek in a room.
[/list]
Lots of new heroes and playstyles to challenge the castle once more...

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334270/Castle_Explorer__Heroes_and_rings/]Link to Heroes and Rings[/url]
